evidence: Full isolated verifier on input ff1fb5e6d8ed0cb7575dff16c57e8cde8e6711b22340ed7bdb2059e60f6c29cc: harness ok, toolchain ok, manifest ok, entitlements ok, build ok, tests ok, package-generator ok, package-toolchain ok, package-system-temporary ok, package-project ok, package-build ok, package-architecture-app ok, package-architecture-helper ok, package-smoke ok, package-helper ok; 577 tests, 0 failures.

Eight isolated cases: the collapse removes only rows inside the object and leaves other evidence identical, an interrupted collapse commits what it finished and resumes, a second pass changes nothing, a repository is stored but never a candidate, and a size without its measurement time cannot be written.

Migration 14 to 15 rehearsed against baseline 97c3a7f15d98, interrupted at each checkpoint and recovered, with the baseline binary refusing the newer schema and the restored backup opening again (AC-TASK-613-01).

Non-vacuity: unbounding the delete, removing the measurement-time constraint, or offering a repository each fails its cases. A fourth mutation changed nothing observable and was discarded rather than counted.

Assurance reviewed: IMPACT-TASK-613-STORE, IMPACT-TASK-613-ASSURANCE confirmed; INSPECT-TASK-613-1 performed after the implementation event and sufficient; drift reconciled; the rollback control now carries the rehearsal this task owed.

limitations: The rehearsal store is synthetic rather than a copy of an installed one.
Nothing measures subtree sizes until TASK-621, so most rows carry no aggregate.
The auditor also implemented the task; independence rests on isolated reruns, three mutation reds and the archived rehearsal.
